description: Classify the instrument and assemble hard facts BEFORE analysts search. Operating companies may receive SEC Company Facts or local-market financials; ETFs and funds receive a holdings look-through contract; indices receive an aggregate-index contract. The result also carries quote, applicable filer profile, options/macro/industry context, explicit not-applicable routes, typed facts, and a prompt block. A searched number never silently overwrites a filed one. Pass the returned `grounding` object to plan_visible_run so every analyst prompt carries it.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD; only filings filed by this date are used.

cik.description: SEC CIK; enables the filer profile and the mechanical screen.

industry.description: Industry query; adds the value-chain participants including non-US names.

language.description: Reader-facing language for subagents and final report, e.g. auto, zh-CN, en-US, ja-JP. Auto infers from prompt.

symbol.description: Exchange ticker. US, HK, JP, KR, CN and TW symbols all work, e.g. AAPL, 0700.HK, 7203.T, 005930.KS, 600519.SS.
